propositions: A new hard-fail CI gate introduced without grandfathering logic causes branches created before the gate to fail retroactively, as evidenced by four escaped regressions (medium-loved-newt, impudent-sodium-ferret, rancid-aerophobic-skylark, brattish-ladyish-jaguar).
Project code-review criteria are dispatched unconditionally regardless of whether the changed files match their intended trigger scope, preventing applies_to globs from gating project criteria.

The code-review criterion system must support vendor-agnostic detection of hard-fail gates without grandfathering, triggerable via declarative globs across multiple CI systems (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, CircleCI, Buildkite, Bitbucket Pipelines, Drone).
Project-specific glob patterns for CI configuration files must be overridable via configuration keys without modifying shipped code.
The new advisory criterion and its supporting infrastructure must be testable offline with balanced pass/fail corpus cases and zero false positives when applied to real reviews.
